notes.text: The page names the notion of a weighted graph with repères and gives its diagram: an indicated subset of vec R, the two labels sigma_0 and sigma_1, an arrow to the oriented-edge set with its sigma loop, then the o map to vertices and gamma to N. It names a groupoid and a functor from S_* T D_top plus-minus. This is an account of the transcribed construction, not a verification of its axioms.

The prose requires an algebraic-combinatorial paradigm to reconstruct the corresponding weighted graph with repères, and the inserted clarification requires recovery of the canonical functor itself rather than only the functor to Grbipond. The first essential operation removes a chosen subset R prime of the repères, taking (X,Sigma,R) to (X,Sigma,R minus R prime). These assertions were not proved in this reading.
The middle prose formula visibly lacks the star beneath S that is present in both displayed functors. No star has been supplied.

The ink has importante after qui sera, and accented réconstituer in both occurrences. These forms, including the agreement surprise, are retained. The singular le graphe pondéré à repères correspondant is the closer reading of the compressed endings; the plural s in uniques is separately visible.

The abbreviation forms are not normalized: upper caption Gr.pndrep, first functor target Grpondrep, inserted target Gr.pond.rep., and final parenthetical Grbipond. The interlinear replacement is the shortened gr.poïde-.

The original image was viewed once, each supplied half once, and nineteen distinct enlarged evidence crops once each. All agreement text, labels, symbols, punctuation, deletion scopes and insertion attachments were read. No OCR, external source, other page packet or TeX compilation was used.
